summary: Apply generative AI to workplace tasks with prompt, output and human-review controls. Explore the 5-day AI generalist course.
lede: Applied AI generalist practice helps analysts, team leads and functional specialists use generative AI in routine work with reviewable results. Learners assess task suitability, design reusable prompts, verify sources and evaluate outputs, while setting data boundaries and human review points. Exercises use fictional work scenarios and a browser-based assistant to create practical checklists and decision records for AI-assisted workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for intermediate professionals who use or evaluate generative AI in routine knowledge, service or analysis work. It suits roles that need to produce reviewable AI-assisted outputs and set sensible boundaries without building models or writing code.
modules: Generative AI and NIST AI RMF
Model Cards and Datasheets for Datasets
OECD AI Principles and Rollout Reporting
prerequisites: Intermediate workplace experience with document, research, analysis or service workflows is recommended. No coding or programming is required. For hands-on exercises, bring a laptop and access to a browser-based generative AI assistant through an account you are authorized to use; no software installation is required.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
